changelog:
Initial release: automatic code quality and security check fixer.

- Runs project quality and security checks across multiple languages (JS/TS, Python, Rust, Go, Swift).
- Automatically analyzes errors and fixes issues in order of priority until all checks pass.
- Supports linting, type checking, tests, security audits, formatting, and build checks.
- Follows a strict loop: check → fix → re-check.
- Only addresses errors reported by project checks; no code commits or version changes are made.
summary: Run project quality checks and security reviews, fixing all errors by priority until all pass.
